limitations: This correctness checkpoint does not close uniform performance or full Hypercurve release readiness.
Memory evidence here is whole-process peak RSS from matched timings, not fresh allocation or complete-heap accounting.
A separate algebraic-only assumption in selected parallel-normal rational contact seeding remains under audit; this patch does not claim to cover it.
ExactCorelib idea mining/uplift remains closed; the lower stack and Hypermesh are unchanged in this slice.

The seven additional pairs retain a +4.3195% degree-12 axis-monotonicity lane and +2.8881% algebraic contact replay; the capsule instruction control is +0.0020027%. These are explicit costs/follow-ups, not a blanket no-regression result.

reproduction.timing_driver:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fiber_evidence="/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-fiber-interval-reuse.SY8G4G"
for fiber_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( fiber_round % 2 )); then
        fiber_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        fiber_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for fiber_case in selected chord radial; do
        case "$fiber_case" in
            selected) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans" ;;
            chord) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict" ;;
            radial) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel" ;;
        esac
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-test" "$fiber_test" \
                --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$fiber_case" "$fiber_round" "$fiber_variant"
        done
    done
    for fiber_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-$fiber_bench" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for fiber_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$fiber_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$fiber_fixture"
        fi
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_fixture-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done
